ns2:section.sectionText: Instructional Strategies for Media Literacy in PK-12-Provides practical curricular frameworks and instructional tools that can be used by classroom teachers and school librarians. This course is built on the premise that media literacy education is paramount to full participation in a Democratic society and that all students deserve practice with these skills under the guidance of a dedicated and trained educator. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
